content.text: Download route is `/api/v1/files/:path`; the stored path omits `files/`.

candidates.explanation: The stored path is `/${apiPrefix}/v1/${file.filename}`. It leaves out the `files` segment. The download route in FilesLocalController is `@Controller({path:'files', version:'1'})` with `@Get(':path')`, so it is served at `/${apiPrefix}/v1/files/:filename`. The returned link therefore points to a route that doesn't exist and gives 404, even though the file is saved on disk.

fix.description: Include the files segment in the stored path: `/${apiPrefix}/v1/files/${file.filename}`.
